components.label: Console body
components.purpose: Four-deck standalone console, 728.47 wide × 496.82 deep × 103.63 high mm and 9.7 kg, with the 10.1-inch touchscreen on a tilting stand at the top centre.
components.limits: Envelope is published; edge profile and control placement are approximate.

components.label: 10.1-inch multi-touch screen
components.purpose: Full-colour multi-touch display on an adjustable angle, with the browse knob, Back, Forward, Load and View buttons beside it (top panel items 1–7).

components.label: Left jog wheel with platter display
components.purpose: Left deck jog with a centre display showing playhead and artwork; the Deck button selects deck 1 or 3.
components.limits: Diameter is not in the guide table (reported: 6-inch).

components.label: Right jog wheel with platter display
components.purpose: Right deck jog; the Deck button selects deck 2 or 4.

components.label: Four channel strips and crossfader
components.purpose: Per channel: channel FX buttons, level, meters, 3-band EQ, sweep FX, cue, fader and crossfader assign (top panel items 8–15); crossfader item 16 with contour and fader start on the front.

components.label: Headphones · 1/4 in and 1/8 in
components.purpose: Front panel item 1: 6.35 mm and 3.5 mm headphone outputs, level from the Phones Level knob, less than 150 mW into 40 Ω.

components.label: Input selectors, fader start, X-fader contour
components.purpose: Front panel items 2–4: Engine/USB or Line per channel, fader start per side, crossfader curve.

components.label: Power input and power button
components.purpose: Rear items 1–2: IEC inlet, 100–240 VAC 50/60 Hz, 38–39 W (43–45 W while charging a phone from USB 4), and the power button with a safe-eject protection circuit.

components.label: Rear USB ports 3/4
components.purpose: Rear item 3: two USB-A ports for drives; port 4 also charges a device at 5 V / 1 A. Two more USB ports and the SD slot are on the top.

components.label: USB B (computer)
components.purpose: Rear item 4: USB-B for MIDI to and from a computer with the included cable.

components.label: Link port · Ethernet
components.purpose: Rear item 5: Ethernet port sending time, BPM and track data to StageLinQ lighting and video software.

components.label: Zone Out · XLR balanced
components.purpose: Rear item 6: balanced XLR pair that mirrors the master by default, or carries deck 4 as a zone playlist with its own level and EQ.

components.label: Booth Outputs · XLR balanced
components.purpose: Rear item 7: balanced XLR booth pair, level from the Booth knob.

components.label: Master Outputs · XLR balanced and RCA
components.purpose: Rear items 8–10: balanced XLR master pair (+24 dBu max, +4 dBu unity), unbalanced RCA master pair, and the Stereo/Mono switch.

components.label: Line and Line/Phono inputs · RCA
components.purpose: Rear items 11–14: two RCA line pairs, two RCA line/phono pairs with the Phono/Line switch, and the grounding terminal for turntables.

components.label: Mic Inputs · XLR or 1/4 in
components.purpose: Rear item 15: two combo microphone inputs for dynamic mics, levels from Mic 1 and Mic 2 on the top. −40 dBu unity.

components.label: Top USB ports 1/2 and SD slot
components.purpose: Two USB-A ports and the SD/SDHC/SDXC slot on the top; a 2.5-inch SATA bay underneath takes an internal drive.

page.practice_cards:
Simulated PRIME 4 state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Zone out for a second room
Zone Out mirrors the master until Zone Channel Assign puts deck 4 on it as a zone playlist. Then channel 4's level and EQ are bypassed and the Zone knobs take over.
Useful for a lobby feed off the same console; not simulated here.
